workflow.name: Student Warning Notification Workflow
workflow.description: When a student receives a warning, notify parents by email and send a summary message to the class teacher via WhatsApp.

actions.description: Notify parents about the student warning via email

config.subject: Warning Notification for Your Child
config.body:
Dear Parent,

We are writing to inform you that your child has received a warning. Please contact the school for further details.

Best regards,
School Administration

actions.description: Send summary message to class teacher via WhatsApp

config.message: Summary: A student has received a warning. Please follow up as needed.
